build_GridHead: build a GridHead instance with 9 grid points and 8 conv layers for RoI feature processing
review_GridHead_forward: review the GridHead forward method that produces fused and unfused heatmap predictions from RoI features
test_GridHead_get_targets: test the GridHead get_targets method to calculate ground truth heatmap targets from sampling results
refactor_GridHead_loss: refactor the GridHead loss method to compute combined fused and unfused grid loss values
summarize_GridHead_predict_by_feat: summarize the GridHead predict_by_feat method that adjusts predicted bboxes using grid heatmap voting
